data_source_caveat: All portals (PropertyGuru/99.co/EdgeProp/SRX/PropNex) returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch. Every price/PSF/size below is triangulated from search-result snippets + project directories, i.e. last-seen snapshot, NOT a live-rendered listing page. Floor level and new-vs-reduced status often unavailable. Re-verify on-portal before acting.

highlights: Best all-round fit: Le Crescendo (D14 Paya Lebar, freehold 2006, 228u) - TWO clean-pass 3BR: 1,313 sqft @ $1.85M ($1,409) and 1,173 sqft @ $1.60M ($1,364). Freehold, 190m to Paya Lebar MRT, well under budget & cap.
Best D19 freehold: The Waterline (Hougang, FH 2013, 103u) - two near-identical 1,173 sqft 3BR at $1.88-1.89M (~$1,605 psf). Small boutique, freehold, clean pass.

Best value / lowest PSF: The Florida (Hougang, 99yr ~70yr, 496u) - multiple 3BR from $1.40M ($1,141 psf). Qualifies under 99yr rule-b. Trade-off = only ~70yr lease (CPF 95-rule OK for buyers aged 25+).
Effective-freehold sleeper: Palm Grove (Hougang, 999-yr/851yr, 111u) - 1,302 sqft @ $1.96M ($1,506). Freehold-equivalent tenure, all 3BR oversized.
Watch-list: Kovan Residences (whitelisted) and Tangerine Grove/Oasis Garden 3BR sit just over $2.3M - flag for a sub-ceiling relist.
